theorem: With k=4(q-1), every nonzero apartment-code indicator x satisfies x^T A_theta^2 x >= k(k+2)|S|.
defect: Delta=x^T A_theta^2 x-k(k+2)|S| is a nonnegative multiple of 8.
equality: Equality holds iff every exterior boundary apartment has exactly two selected theta-neighbors.
boundary: The q=2 equality shell is complete. For q>2 this certificate does not assert that chamber stars are the only zero-curvature supports.
